query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `security_credentials` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `application_id` int NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `ssl_certificate` text,
  `certificate_chain` text,
  `certificate_expiry` timestamp,
  `api_key` varchar(255),
  `oauth_client_id` varchar(255),
  `oauth_client_secret` varchar(255),
  `jwt_public_key` text,
  `public_key` text,
  `private_key_encrypted` text,
  `pgp_key_id` varchar(100),
  `hsm_enabled` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `network_configurations` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `application_id` int NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `vpn_required` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `vpn_type` varchar(50),
  `vpn_endpoint` varchar(500),
  `load_balancer_endpoint` varchar(500),
  `health_check_url` varchar(500),
  `timeout_seconds` int DEFAULT 30,
  `retry_policy` text,
  `topology_diagram_url` varchar(500),
  `firewall_rules_doc` varchar(500),
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `compliance_documents` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `application_id` int NOT NULL,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `document_type` varchar(100) NOT NULL,
  `document_url` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `document_name` varchar(255) NOT NULL,
  `expiry_date` timestamp,
  `data_storage_location` varchar(100),
  `cross_border_transfer` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `gdpr_compliant` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `verified` boolean DEFAULT false,
  `verified_by` int,
  `verified_at` timestamp,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `technical_onboarding_reviews` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT NOT NULL,
  `application_id` int NOT NULL,
  `reviewer_id` int NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','approved','rejected','corrections_requested') NOT NULL,
  `endpoint_connectivity_test` boolean,
  `certificate_validation` boolean,
  `compliance_verification` boolean,
  `comments` text,
  `corrections_required` text,
  `reviewed_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY(`id`)
)
